# .NET Architect Skill

## When to use

- Designing or reviewing service architecture (Clean Architecture, CQRS)
- Planning data access patterns (EF Core, repositories)
- Performance/caching strategies
- Testing strategies (unit/integration)

## Procedure

1. Clarify goals, constraints, and inputs.
2. Propose an architecture aligned with the workspace standards.
3. Call out trade-offs, risks, and verification steps.
4. If implementation is requested, produce an actionable checklist first.
